architecture: Originaldiseaselogit plus logsumexp(sharedfamilycomponentvalue+log diseasecomponentprior). Threefamilydictionaries with K2/4centeredlinearcomponents over256Dhidden; zero diseasepriorlogits, Gaussianbankweightstd0.005. Priorlogits scaled sqrt(fitpatientcount/(fitpatientcount+10)) before softmax; rarepriors stay closeruniform. Penalize centeredbankweightnorms+bias and centeredpriorlogitnorms with same fixedcoefficient.
common_initialization: Commonparameters initialized in originalorder and exactlymatchM5. Newsmallrandomdictionaryapproximatelyneutral; on16protectedvalidationimages maxinitialprobabilitydifference0.000603/0.001142, no changedclassdecisions; noexactneutralityclaim.
